name: Invoice Generation and Payment
description: Verifies that an admin can create an invoice, add items, and settle it with M-Pesa.

planSteps.description: Click 'Create Invoice', add a customer and some products, and save the invoice.
Click the 'Settle' button on the newly created invoice.
Select 'M-Pesa' as the payment method, enter the full amount and a valid 10-digit M-Pesa receipt (e.g., 'ABC1234567'), then confirm.
Assert that the invoice status changes to 'Paid' or a success message is displayed.
